_comment: Material tiers. Every tier makes the same seven pieces, and the game builds the items and their recipes from this file: see ItemDatabase::LoadTiers. A piece's stats are its tier's power times the piece's factors; its requirement is the tier's level in the piece's skill. 'ids' and 'names' keep the items that existed before tiers under their old ids, so saves, quests and loot tables still find them.

sword.desc: A straight blade and a plain grip.

bow.desc: Takes both hands, and a steady eye.

staff.desc: It carries a spell further than a bare hand can.

shield.desc: Something to put between you and the worst of it.

helm.desc: Narrow eye slit. You get used to it.

legs.desc: Shin and thigh plates, strapped over the hose.

tiers.name: Wooden
tiers.flavour: Seasoned wood, carved and pegged. Better than bare hands.

tiers.name: Bronze
tiers.ore_desc: Green-streaked rock. Heavier than it has any right to be.
tiers.flavour: Soft metal, honest edge. It will see you through the meadow.

tiers.name: Iron
tiers.ore_desc: Dull red and dense. The forge will know what to do with it.
tiers.flavour: Heavier in the hand, and it bites far deeper than bronze.

tiers.name: Steel
tiers.ore_desc: Black, greasy and brittle. Iron needs it to become steel.
tiers.flavour: Guild-forged. The kind of work that ends an argument early.

tiers.name: Azuryte
tiers.ore_desc: Blue veins in pale stone that stay faintly lit in the dark.
tiers.flavour: Sky-blue metal that rings like a bell and never quite goes cold.

tiers.name: Adamantium
tiers.ore_desc: Green-black and so hard a pick skids off it more often than not.
tiers.flavour: Deep green and nearly unbreakable. Heavy, and worth it.

tiers.name: Diamond
tiers.ore_desc: A clouded crystal still half in its rock.
tiers.flavour: Crystal fused into a working edge. It throws the light back at you.

tiers.name: Platinum
tiers.ore_desc: Grains of pale metal that do not tarnish, whatever you do to them.
tiers.flavour: White metal with gold at the fittings. Made for a champion.

tiers.name: Demonrite
tiers.ore_desc: Black glass with a red heat inside. It came back from a nightmare.
tiers.flavour: Forged from what nightmares are made of. It is warm, and it is hungry.
